statement: A dropped or reordered CDC DELETE never leaves a permanently resurrected row in any downstream system-table cache: for every internalCachePropagation table, after a missed or late DELETE all replica caches converge to authoritative absence within a bounded interval, proven by a deterministic regression test plus a green suite.
